headline: Trilegal advises DailyObjects on ₹332 crore Series C fundraise

detail: Firki Wholesale Private Limited, dba DailyObjects, has raised ₹332 crore from a Series C fundraise led by Xponentia Capital Partners, Anicut Capital, and Axiom Asia Private Capital. The transaction is structured as a combination of a primary capital infusion into Daily Objects by Xponentia Capital Partners, Anicut Capital, Axiom Asia Private Capital, Sattva Family Office, and certain angel investors and a secondary sale of securities by an existing institutional investor and founders of DailyObjects. Trilegal advised DailyObjects on this fundraise. The Firm's scope of work involved: drafting, negotiating and finalizing the transaction documents including shareholders' agreement, share…
